subject: Annual committed funds: execution matrix, invoice numbering, and tax handoff
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Acme Analytics Procurement <procure@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Annual committed funds: execution matrix, invoice numbering, and tax handoff

Hi Lars / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for committing to the annual package (D-ACME-2026-08). To make month-to-month drawdowns smooth on both sides, I attached a suggested execution matrix that maps committed tranches to invoice dates, PO references, and the exact invoice numbering format we intend to use. Please review and confirm AP details so we can schedule the first invoice for Sept 1.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm exact AP email and billing contact who will receive PDF invoices (we prefer a single inbox for auto-ingest).
- Confirm PO number format you require on the invoice (we propose: ACME-PO-YYYY-#####).
- Confirm whether Acme requires EU VAT evidence per country (we have sample VAT evidence attached for Spain) and whether you accept redacted copies for initial invoice.
- Any special GL or cost-center strings we should put in the invoice lines to ease your ledger mapping.

Attachments: commitment_execution_matrix.xlsx, invoice-numbering-sample.pdf, VAT-evidence-ES.pdf, signed-sow-acme.pdf

If you prefer, Marcus can run a short 20-minute ops call with your AP to confirm the ingest fields and PO matching rules. Proposed time slots are Wed 19 Aug 09:00 or Thu 20 Aug 15:00 CEST.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+44 20 5555 0123

Redwood Inference | Trusted inference at production scale
From: Lars Jensen <lars.jensen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Analytics Procurement <procure@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:08:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Annual committed funds: execution matrix, invoice numbering, and tax handoff

Hi Olga,

Appreciate the clear matrix — looks good. A few quick points from Acme AP:
- Invoices should be emailed to ap-europe@acme-analytics.com (single inbox).
- PO format we use is ACME-PO-2026-XXXXX (5 digits). We will generate one master PO for the full annual commitment and then reference the tranche id on each invoice.
- VAT: for Spain and France we need VAT registration evidence on file; redacted copies are OK for the initial invoice but we will need full copies before the second tranche.
- GL/Cost center: please include the following string on each invoice line: GL: 4102-ML-AI.

I'll attach a brief AP intake template — see attached (I uploaded to your Drive link). We can do the 20-minute call on Wed 19 Aug 09:00 CEST. Marta will join on the AP side.

Regards,
Lars Jensen
Head of Procurement, Acme Analytics
lars.jensen@acme-analytics.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Annual committed funds: execution matrix, invoice numbering, and tax handoff

Adding internal ops details so we can be ready after the AP call. Notes on invoice numbering and ledgers:
- Proposed invoice numbering pattern: RW-ACME-2026-T01, RW-ACME-2026-T02, etc. (T# corresponds to tranche number). Attached sample shows numbering and PDF layout.
- For ledger posting we'll use revenue GL 4102 and deferred liability GL 2201 for the prepaid portion. Naomi: can you confirm tax code mapping for Spain/France if VAT evidence is partial at time of invoice?
- We should lock the first invoice to not include VAT (reverse charge) if Acme confirms reverse charge applies; otherwise invoice gross with VAT.

If AP needs a PO field mapping, we'll include a header on the invoice: PO: ACME-PO-2026-XXXXX | TRANCHE: T01 | CONTRACT: D-ACME-2026-08

I'll prep the draft invoice PDFs after the AP call.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Revenue Accountant, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Annual committed funds: execution matrix, invoice numbering, and tax handoff

Quick tax handoff from my side following Lars' note:
- Spain/France: we can accept redacted VAT registration for the first tranche but must obtain full copies before the second tranche payment is released. I'll prepare a standardized evidence checklist and attach to the Drive folder (will label "VAT-evidence-checklist_EU.pdf").
- Reverse charge: Acme needs to confirm in writing if they will self-account for VAT. If confirmed, invoices will be issued net of VAT and must include the reverse charge statement.
- If Acme does not self-account, we'll bill with VAT at the applicable rate and provide the invoice as gross.

Also, for internal control: please ensure the signed SOW (signed-sow-acme.pdf) is referenced on each invoice as: SOW-ID: SOW-ACME-2026-A.

I'll join the call at 09:00 CEST to answer any VAT questions.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Tax & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Lars Jensen <lars.jensen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Analytics Procurement <procure@acme-analytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 17:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Annual committed funds: execution matrix, invoice numbering, and tax handoff

Thanks everyone — confirmed items after the call:
- AP inbox: ap-europe@acme-analytics.com (use this for PDF invoice delivery).
- We will provide a master PO (ACME-PO-2026-12345) by EOD Aug 20; please reference it on all invoices.
- We will self-account for VAT for Spain and France (reverse charge). Please issue invoices net of VAT with the reverse charge language: \"Reverse charge — Article 194 VAT Directive\" and include our VAT numbers.
- Attached is the completed AP intake form (we uploaded to your Drive).

We are good to receive the first tranche invoice on Sept 1 as suggested. Marta will confirm the final AP contact on Sept 1 if anything changes.

Regards,
Lars
